scientific_warning: Pixel motion depends on camera perspective, zoom, and camera movement. These are not real-world distances or speeds. Camera calibration and perspective correction are needed to measure physical units. Normalized distance divides pixel distance by the frame diagonal.

basketball.rate_definition: Frames with a selected visible sports-ball candidate / frames processed; not precision, recall, or accuracy.

possession_proxy.warning: Temporally confirmed image proximity does not prove physical possession.

event_rules.score_definition: Fixed rule-strength scores, not calibrated probabilities; events are candidates, not ground truth.

performance.measurement: Video processing through encoder close; excludes model loading and sidecar publication.
